name: @mansoldev/framework
description: A modern CSS framework powered by Sass and PostCSS.

scripts.dev: node scripts/build-themes.js && pnpm exec astro dev --root website
scripts.dev:root: node scripts/build-themes.js && pnpm exec vite --config vite.config.js
scripts.build:framework: node scripts/clean.js --framework && node scripts/build-themes.js && pnpm exec vite build --config vite.config.framework.js
scripts.build:root: node scripts/build-themes.js && pnpm exec vite build --config vite.config.js
scripts.build: pnpm run clean && pnpm run build:website
